confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from learned general knowledge, brought forward to July 2026; no live listings or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderately reliable; July accommodation rates swing widely, so they are less certain. EUR/USD was assumed near 1.15 without a live check, so USD anchors move with the euro. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against beer. Accommodation is assumed to exclude city tourist tax. The RBA rate comes from a search-result report of the RBA overview page; the F11.1 table itself could not be opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked to major Italian tourist cities such as Florence and Venice, with a Rome-specific adjustment for its large hotel market and July peak-season demand. No specific listings were checked.
